piece.purpose: Authoritative build definition and permanent game-resource identity for DD RHW-4 Level 1 (7.5 m) and Level 2 (15 m) over GHSR Ground (1 m) — Mixed Crossing — Both Diagonal 90° — Alignment B.
piece.name: DD RHW-4 Level 1 (7.5 m) and Level 2 (15 m) over GHSR Ground (1 m) — Mixed Crossing — Both Diagonal 90° — Alignment B
piece.description: Alignment B fits the alternate diagonal railway position beneath the same directed double-decker highway. Two horizontal fixed tiles and four native approaches provide independent rail and highway through routes. When both alignments are selected, Tab changes between A and B from the original crossing button.

provenance.geometry: Pinned NAM 50 native six-mesh DD halves and ordinary GHSR valid track mesh.
provenance.construction: Two protected DirtRoad/Monorail cells; four disjoint dynamic native helpers; four proper rotations repeated.
